title: msHwr - bewitched
html:
Graph connections

Root

  • sHr - sahar

Meaning

bewitched · Lemma مَسْحُور

Surahs (3)

  • 015 Al-Hijr
  • 017 Al-Isra
  • 025 Al-Furqan

Verses (full text)

Arabic + English (Sahih International) + English (Yusuf Ali). Showing up to 10 verses.

15:15 · 015 Al-Hijr

لَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَـٰرُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ مَّسْحُورُونَ

Word in this verse: مَّسْحُورُونَ — bewitched

English (Sahih International): They would say, "Our eyes have only been dazzled. Rather, we are a people affected by magic."

English (Yusuf Ali): They would only say: "Our eyes have been intoxicated: Nay, we have been bewitched by sorcery."

17:47 · 017 Al-Isra

نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَسْتَمِعُونَ بِهِۦٓ إِذْ يَسْتَمِعُونَ إِلَيْكَ وَإِذْ هُمْ نَجْوَىٰٓ إِذْ يَقُولُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلًا مَّسْحُورًا

Word in this verse: مَّسْحُورًا — bewitched

English (Sahih International): We are most knowing of how they listen to it when they listen to you and [of] when they are in private conversation, when the wrongdoers say, "You follow not but a man affected by magic."

English (Yusuf Ali): We know best why it is they listen, when they listen to thee; and when they meet in private conference, behold, the wicked say, "Ye follow none other than a man bewitched!"

17:101 · 017 Al-Isra

وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ تِسْعَ ءَايَـٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍ ۖ فَسْـَٔلْ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِذْ جَآءَهُمْ فَقَالَ لَهُۥ فِرْعَوْنُ إِنِّى لَأَظُنُّكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ مَسْحُورًا

Word in this verse: مَسْحُورًۭا — (you are) bewitched

English (Sahih International): And We had certainly given Moses nine evident signs, so ask the Children of Israel [about] when he came to them and Pharaoh said to him, "Indeed I think, O Moses, that you are affected by magic."

English (Yusuf Ali): To Moses We did give Nine Clear Signs: As the Children of Israel: when he came to them, Pharaoh said to him: "O Moses! I consider thee, indeed, to have been worked upon by sorcery!

25:8 · 025 Al-Furqan

أَوْ يُلْقَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِ كَنزٌ أَوْ تَكُونُ لَهُۥ جَنَّةٌ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهَا ۚ وَقَالَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلًا مَّسْحُورًا

Word in this verse: مَّسْحُورًا — bewitched

English (Sahih International): Or [why is not] a treasure presented to him [from heaven], or does he [not] have a garden from which he eats?" And the wrongdoers say, "You follow not but a man affected by magic."

English (Yusuf Ali): "Or (Why) has not a treasure been bestowed on him, or why has he (not) a garden for enjoyment?" The wicked say: "Ye follow none other than a man bewitched."
